name: Buckshot Bourbon
summary: Four longtime friends from Long Island, New York, blending country soul, hard-rock edges, and honest storytelling.
quote: Real music. Real friends. No apologies.

biography.short: Buckshot Bourbon is Tucker Kennedy's warm voice and easy grin, David Daniels' intensity and grit, Colt McCrae's showman energy, and Jackson Reilly's steady rhythmic engine.
biography.full: Buckshot Bourbon is a four-piece modern country rock band from Long Island, New York. Tucker “Tuck” Kennedy and David “Fireball” Daniels grew up three houses apart in Smithtown, New York. They became friends as children and were inspired to learn guitar after attending a live concert at Jones Beach. In middle school they met Colt “Buckshot” McCrae, whose energy and personality quickly made him part of the group. During high school, David noticed freshman Jackson Reilly's natural rhythmic ability and invited him to play with the group. Jackson joined after an unforgettable garage session. The four spent years developing their sound through garage rehearsals, covers, school events, house parties, and eventually Long Island and New York City bar gigs. Their music evolved into a blend of country soul, hard-rock edges, and Long Island storytelling. After building a local following and independently recording and selling original material, Buckshot Bourbon was discovered by a Quantum Frequency Records representative at a packed Huntington, New York bar show. The band subsequently signed with the label.
